findings.note: Introduced by Sen. Lewis: a proposed constitutional amendment for the November 2026 ballot that would repeal the current Article I, Section 23 right-to-keep-and-bear-arms text (strict scrutiny standard) and replace it with a section letting counties, St. Louis and Kansas City regulate possession, carrying and transfer of firearms by ordinance, with capped permit fees, background checks allowed, and recognition of other Missouri counties' permits.
